reviews.text:
Awful! Liar! Unsanitary!

I feel terrible for my dog ​​because I trusted the doctor at this Neo Animal Hospital.

My dog ​​was subjected to many unnecessary and meaningless tests, which only caused him stress.

The amount of medication the doctor prescribed at the end was also unreasonable and put a great strain on my dog's body.

You can tell just by looking at the filthy, uncleaned air conditioner in the waiting room (it's pitch black from below! It smells of mold!), but the whole place is not properly managed, so it's risky to entrust your precious pet here. This is the worst animal hospital. The doctor is getting old, and his judgment and senses as a veterinarian are dulling; I think he should retire. Please consider the possibility that many people are suffering from the things the doctor is doing without thinking. I want to sue! It's truly, truly the worst!

I've been a patient here for about 20 years.

Rabbits, cats

The veterinarian is very caring and attentive.

When I told them I got a second opinion at another hospital, they made a very obvious face of displeasure and their attitude changed completely.

This hospital must exist because it's full of people who believe that what the doctor says is always right.

Even though they're by appointment only, it's very difficult to get through on the phone, and it always goes to voicemail. The message it leaves is too long, and they take a long time to return the call.

Even though this is a veterinary hospital that deals with lives, I can't rely on them in an emergency.

I don't understand why this hospital has such good reviews.

The doctor and nurses are very kind. The doctor explains things carefully and slowly, and listens attentively to what you have to say. The prices are reasonable, making it easy to visit. Appointments can only be made by phone, and they cannot answer the phone during consultations, so you need to prepare for your appointment in advance.

I've been taking care of my rabbit for many years. I'm always grateful for their kind and attentive service, even for urgent same-day appointments for symptoms like stasis during molting season. By the way, the phone line is always busy.
If you can't get through on the phone, you should be able to make reservations online nowadays.

Even though appointments are only available until 5 pm, I can never get through when I call, and they only return my voicemail an hour later (before closing time). The fact that online booking isn't available is incredibly inconvenient.

I couldn't shake off my initial distrust of my regular veterinary clinic, so after searching extensively, I finally found this animal hospital.

Two years ago, when my beloved dog was diagnosed with a brain tumor, they offered various suggestions, and thanks to them, my dog ​​was able to move around healthily, eat well, and live a full life.

Although they are always fully booked, I highly recommend this animal hospital to anyone living in Osaka City.

Since it's run by just the doctor and two nurses, you need an appointment, and even if you call ahead to order medication, you'll still have to wait if they're in the middle of a procedure. I was really annoyed when I waited for over 30 minutes. In the past, there were two doctors and about two staff members, so the service was quick and good. Now it's a bit different...
